name: computer_control
description: Perform one approval-gated action against a fresh Windows observation. Visual actions can target captured-image coordinates or observation-scoped UI Automation element ids. invoke and set_value use semantic Windows UI Automation patterns without moving the user's pointer; pointer/keyboard actions use foreground input. Each observation is single-use for control, process/title and visual freshness are revalidated, and the result includes a new hybrid observation plus perceptual change verification. Auto delivery prefers actual UI Automation invocation patterns for single element clicks. Use set_value for exact replacement, including clearing and long multiline text; type_text sends keyboard input. Background requests never silently fall back to foreground input.

action.description: Approved desktop input action to perform.

observation_id.description: Fresh token returned by computer_observe or the previous computer_control result.

window_id.description: Window id from the referenced observation.

element_id.description: Observation-scoped semantic element id. Preferred over x/y for click, move_mouse, scroll, invoke, set_value, and exact-target type_text.

to_element_id.description: Observation-scoped destination element id for drag.

coordinate_space.description: How x/y/to_x/to_y are interpreted. Defaults to captured_image_pixels.

x.description: X coordinate in the referenced captured image. Required for mouse actions.

y.description: Y coordinate in the referenced captured image. Required for mouse actions.

to_x.description: Destination X coordinate in the referenced captured image. Required for drag.

to_y.description: Destination Y coordinate in the referenced captured image. Required for drag.

button.description: Mouse button for click. Defaults to left.

scroll_x.description: Horizontal wheel steps; positive scrolls right.

scroll_y.description: Vertical wheel steps; positive scrolls down.

text.description: set_value replaces the full value and accepts 0..65536 characters; empty clears the field. type_text enters 1..8000 characters with at most 32 newline/tab controls. Prefer set_value for forms and multiline documents when the element offers it. Other controls and password fields are rejected.

key_sequence.description: One chord such as ctrl+s, shift+tab, escape, or f5. Non-final keys must be modifiers; bare text-producing keys are rejected. Required for key.

reason.description: Optional reason, summarized by character count in approval and audit output rather than persisted verbatim.

include_elements.description: Include semantic elements in the fresh post-action observation. Defaults to true.

max_elements.description: Maximum semantic elements in the post-action observation. Defaults to 120.

capture_mode.description: raw returns the normal post-action screenshot; som overlays semantic element ids. Defaults to raw.

approval_scope.description: Defaults to action. For a multi-step task in one window, window_session offers the user a reusable Allow for session grant bound to the verified process/window and current task; fresh observations remain required. It never grants access automatically.

delivery.description: auto prefers native UI Automation for invokable single left clicks on element_id. background requires a usable semantic pattern and never sends foreground mouse/keyboard input; the target application may still activate itself. foreground forces pointer/keyboard delivery; invoke/set_value are always background.

drag_duration_ms.description: Drag duration in milliseconds, defaults to 400. Increase for applications requiring a longer hold. Only valid for drag.
